name: PANEL
title: PANEL — kit master switch · J50
sub: NKK WT22S DPDT ON-NONE-ON (toggle UP = ON) + APEM Q8 2 V status LED · J50 housing 43025-0600 · crimps 43030-0007 · 20 AWG throughout

led.heading: STATUS LED — APEM Q8 · green · 2 V
led.note: board resistor R58 1k sets ~10 mA — no series R in harness

wires: SW_ARM (arms K50 master relay via Q50)
ES_FEED — ALWAYS HOT (13 V via R92 470R)

warning.title: ⚠ LIVE WITH KIT SWITCHED OFF
lines: Pin 3 ES_FEED ≈13 V whenever the battery is connected (VCAP_IN → F50 → D50 → /ES_RX → R92 470R —
does NOT pass through the master relay). Pin 4 PWR_SW ≈13 V via R61 470k (weak). Treat both as live.

footer: Toggle UP: pole 1 jumpers pin 3 → pin 2 (ES_FEED → SW_ARM arms K50 via Q50 follower) · pole 2 jumpers pin 4 → pin 5 (PWR_SW → GND enables the LM5176) — matches sheet ghosts S50/S52
One wire per contact, crimp-to-crimp, no splices · J50 was XH-6 single-row — now Micro-Fit 2×3, pin numbers 1:1 · schematic rev c md5 26db7fab · PNs per switch-sourcing.md (pending approval)
